The Honorable Rogers C. B. Morton The Honorable Earl L. Butz Page 2 July 6, 1972

to me that the President did not indicate otherwise. The American Mining Congress has endorsed revisions of the 1872 Mining Law that would have the effect of modernizing and updating this statute. Certainly the mining industry has indicated its willingness to cooperate but it must object to the proposed regulation of off-road vehicles as it would affect legitimate mineral development activities on the public lands.
Thank you for the opportunity to bring these views to your attention.
Sincerely,
W. Howard Gray
Chairman
AMC Public Lands Committee
W. Howard Gray.
